content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-82. - Criminal liability of an individual for corporate conduct.
content.summary:

               performs or causes to occur in the name of or in behalf of a business entity to the

faqs.q: Sec. 62-82. - Criminal liability of an individual for corporate conduct.
faqs.a:
A person is criminally liable for conduct constituting an offense which the person
               performs or causes to occur in the name of or in behalf of a business entity to the
               same extent as if that conduct were performed or caused by the person in their own
               name or behalf.
(Ord. No.
4847
, § 5, 7-10-2023)
